name: Kaltern an der Weinstraße (Italy)
description: Hanging banner with vertical stripes of white, red and white, charged with the municipal arms of Kaltern an der Weinstraße (a wine cask on white).
history: Municipal flag of Kaltern an der Weinstraße, a comune in Trentino-South Tyrol; Italian municipal arms, gonfaloni and flags are granted by decree of the President of the Republic on the advice of the Government's heraldry office.

features.role: Kaltern arms — wine cask on white
